# E02 — off-surface ruling

A second ruling series inside the same experiment, numbering from one independently.
Keyed on the leading E-number these rulings would collide with E02-ruling.md's.

## Ruling 1 — the off-surface margin is BANKED as a measured phenomenon

2026-02-03. The margin is a statistic about a structure rather than a constant of the
bake, and it is named here so later arcs cite the name instead of re-deriving it.

## Ruling 2 — the margin statistic is MEASURED per structure

2026-02-04. A global constant must not govern a local feature, so the statistic is
derived per structure and the report says per structure what the operation changed.
